title: From NFTs to Dinosaurs: Crypto Elite Turn to Ultra-Rare Tangible Assets
summary: Wintermute’s Yoann Turpin and other crypto investors bought a rare triceratops fossil, signaling a shift from NFTs to ultra-scarce physical assets. The post From NFTs to Dinosaurs: Crypto Elite Turn to Ultra-Rare Tangible Assets appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: Europe Tries to Buy Time for Car Industry Stuck in the Present
summary: Europe’s embattled automakers are set to get a breather as they struggle with the transition to emission-free driving, a critical moment that will shape the future of the continent’s transport sector for better or worse.
